name: scriptorium-free
description: Lets the Scriptorium Memorialium page reach free LLM APIs and FreeLLMAPI from inside the Claude app, and keeps your API keys safe on this computer across updates.
long_description: The Scriptorium page inside the Claude app may not contact outside addresses, so its free-model modes could not run there. This extension makes those requests from your own computer: the page passes it a request to an OpenAI-compatible endpoint and reads the answer back as it streams. It only calls https addresses ending in /models or /chat/completions, and servers on this computer. Your keys stay in the page's own storage and pass through here only on their way to their provider.
